name: @repowiki/core
description: Shared interfaces and types for repowiki-cli

scripts.prepack: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const all={...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies,...p.peerDependencies,...p.optionalDependencies};const bad=Object.entries(all).filter(([,v])=>v&&v.startsWith('workspace:'));if(bad.length){console.error('ERR: workspace: refs not resolved: '+bad.map(([k])=>k).join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
